scripts.build: node --input-type=module --eval "import { rmSync } from 'node:fs'; rmSync('dist', { recursive: true, force: true });" && tsc -p tsconfig.json
scripts.test: npm run build --silent && npm run jest:run
scripts.test:unit: npm run build --silent && npm run jest:run -- --testPathPatterns=dist/tests/unit/
scripts.test:integration: npm run build --silent && npm run jest:run -- --testPathPatterns=dist/tests/integration/
scripts.test:file: npm run build --silent && npm run jest:run -- --runTestsByPath
